data.summary: UI sequence supported H1: imported PersistenceProbe, saved PatchPersistence, confirmed deletion and empty list, saved, exited, reopened, and saw PersistenceProbe again. However, the final-frame verifier did not accept this as proof because a single screenshot cannot establish the prior deletion/save/reopen sequence. Leaving the returned patch visible; no claim of Android/build-specific verification.
